notes.title: Bounty City Free-to-Play Transition Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,
We sincerely thank all of you for your continued support and love for our game.

Today, we’d like to share an important update with you.
We have decided to transition our VR FPS title, Bounty City, from its current $10.99 USD paid model to a Free-to-Play model, effective May 8, 2025.

🎁 Compensation for Existing Paid Users
We deeply appreciate everyone who has purchased the game, and to thank you for your support, we will be providing the following rewards to all existing purchasers within one week of the transition:

1 exclusive skin

10,000 coins
(Rewards will be automatically credited to your account.)

This Free-to-Play transition marks a new chapter for Bounty City.
We hope to share an even broader and more exciting experience with more players around the world.

We kindly ask for your continued feedback and support—and we hope you’ll join us in welcoming this exciting new change!

Thank you.
– The Bounty City Development Team

* Please note that the date may change depending on Steam's scheduling.

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 Update
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the number of servers
 - The original 7 servers (channels) have been reduced to 3 to allow for more matches
 - New servers may be added in the future depending on the number of players

2. weapon improvements
 - Animations have been changed to naturally adapt to the intensity of the recoil of the weapon
 - Fixed an issue that caused bullets to be ejected when grabbing a gun  

3. other improvements and bugfixes
 - Added an effect to make the guide sign more visible when no one is holding the bag
 - Made some design changes to the bag
 - Fixed an issue where other users' magazines were not visible under certain conditions

notes.title: V 0.1.4 (Outpost Update!)
notes.content:
Version 0.1.4 Update
1. UI Improvements
 - The entire UI has been redesigned with a fresh new look.
2. Background Additions and Enhancements
 - A new map, "Outpost," has been added.
 - Adjusted the floor detection in the Town map to match and eliminate awkward areas.
 - Fixed flickering objects in the Office map.
3. Miscellaneous Improvements and Bug Fixes
 - Adjusted gun sounds to be audible from a greater distance.
 - Enhanced animations for opponent characters.
 - Fixed abnormal color representation issues in some hat items.

notes.title: Version 0.1.3 update (Gun Update)
notes.content:
1. weapon improvements
 - Changed the overall size and color of the guns
 - Fixed an issue where the gun's aim would not accurately follow the controller when holding the weapon with both hands
 - Fixed an issue with hands digging into the gun on some weapons
 - Made some changes to weapon recoil and damage
 - Adjusted the minimum viewing distance to allow you to see your gun at closer range
 - Added one new weapon

2. background improvements
 - Added a place to practice shooting in the lobby
 - Fixed an issue where the background of the rail shooter was too dark
 - Some structures on the Port map have been repositioned and the overall brightness has been increased
 - Fixed some misplaced structures on the Town map

3. Other improvements and bugfixes
 - Fixed a blurry appearance when selecting a character in the lobby
 - Changed the voice of the in-game narration
 - Changed AI characters' outfits to be brighter
 - Reduced the damage of AI characters to 40%.
 - Item locations are now displayed periodically
 - Changed the narration and background music during matches
 - Footsteps, grenade explosions, etc. can now be heard from a greater distance
 - Changed some effects related to players, such as shadows and spawning
 - Reduced the invulnerability time when a player is respawned from 5 seconds to 3 seconds

notes.title: Version 0.1.2 update (New Map & In-Battle Items)
notes.content:
1. game mode improvements
 - Adjusted the placement of some objects on the Town map
 - Office map spawn point adjustment (a little further away from your bag when you respawn in combat)

2. Weapon improvements
 - Changed the look of current weapons
 - Added new weapons 
 - Added recoil to weapons. Reduced recoil if you hold the weapon with both hands.
 - Gun sounds have been changed
 - Prevented weapons from firing through walls
 - Fixed an issue where grenades had an unusually wide range

3. Main menu changes
 - Added the ability to create rooms. You can now create private rooms with a password and join them from the room list

4. Strategic Consumable Placement
 - Items spawn throughout the battlefield that can restore health or replenish bullets and grenades
 - Items respawn 30 seconds after being picked up
 - There is a limit to how much of each item you can pick up

5. New map (Cargo terminal) added

6. Other improvements and bugfixes
 - Removed Christmas-related objects from the lobby
 - Added background music in the lobby
 - Fixed the sign at the entrance to the shop 
 - Fixed bot players not showing Bot in their name
 - Changed the visualization of player deaths
 - Added UI to provide directions when the bag location is out of view

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Hotfixes
notes.content:
1. improvements and bugfixes
 - Modified the ability to grab from a greater distance 
 - Fixed an issue where some weapons' 3D objects were not visible in the equipment UI
 - Redesigned the main UI to make it more intuitive to use
 - Fixed an issue where hats worn by you would appear to be worn by other players as well
 - Fixed an issue with the Mark character's hand shape not matching the player's motion
 - Fixed an issue where weapons would not function correctly when respawning after dying with an empty magazine
 - Fixed an issue where bullets would get stuck instead of flying when firing while going backwards
 - Fixed an issue where dying and respawning with a pistol weapon would result in a pistol magazine appearing when picking up a rifle weapon.
 - Reduced the damage dealt by the Federal Marshal AI in solo play to 70%.
 - Fixed the following issues when playing continuously without leaving the room after the game ends
1) Scores would not reset properly
2) Some players were immobilized at startup
3) Background music in the waiting room continues to the next battlefield

notes.title: Version 0.1.0 update (New Gameplay Mode Update!)
notes.content:
1. game mode change
 - The default game mode has been changed to 'Money bag' mode
 - The team with the most points at the end of the time limit wins
 - Possession of the money bag during the match will earn you points, and the team that owns the bag at the end will get a big score

2. Shop items added
 - 4 new characters have been added to the shop (Blaster, Welder, Spawn, Ali)
 - Public skins for characters to wear on their heads have been added to the store

3. New weapons added
 - Two new primary weapons have been added
 - New weapons require their own conditions to unlock

4. UI improvements
 - Some colors in the main UI have been changed

5. other improvements and bug fixes
 - Fixed background music playing too low when losing a battle
 - The content of some missions has changed as game modes have changed
- Some changes to the look and sound of firearms

notes.title: Update v0.0.10 (Shop Added!)
notes.content:
1. Added shop and commodity system
 - Added a commodity store and a general store in the lobby room
 - In the current AppLab version, you can only purchase goods through the Meta payment system.
 - Items purchased in the store will be added to your inventory and can be equipped.
 - Characters, character skins, weapon skins, etc. will be added.

2. UI design changes
 - Fixed the UI not appearing right away in the intro
 - The main UI of the lobby has been redesigned
 - Some pages on the Dashboard have been changed from opening on the web to being viewed in-game
 - Room Leader players will be visible in the Match Waiting Room
 - Added the ability to select maps, rounds, and bot presence while in the Match Waiting Room

3. Changes to default characters
 - Three new default characters have been added
 - With the addition of the Shop in the Lobby, the previously freely available paid characters have been changed to unavailable. 
 - Four characters - Jack, Skier, Eddie, and Sana - have been prioritized for inclusion in the Shop

4. Other improvements and bug fixes
 - Fixed the UI not appearing immediately after the intro
 - Fixed broken graphics on some weapons
 - Fixed some weapon damage and rate of fire issues
 - Improved the appearance of hands when another player is holding a weapon
 - Fixed some graphics on the town map

notes.title: Version 0.0.9 Update
notes.content:
23/11/21 Bug fix
1. mitigated an issue where other players' animations would appear to stutter excessively
2. fixed an issue where some users could no longer progress past the login screen

notes.title: Version 0.0.8 Update
notes.content:
1. Changes to the maximum number of players in a match
- Matches with a maximum of 3vs3vs3 have been changed to 2vs2vs2

2. Improvements and Bug Fixes
- Changed the structure of the office map
- Optimized characters, weapons, vfx, and backgrounds
- Slowed down the movement speed of bots(AI) and made them a little less aggressive

notes.title: Update 0.0.5
notes.content:
1. Added bots
- Bot players have been added to allow for solo play
- If there are not enough players in a room, bots(AI) will automatically join the vacant spots.
- The bot will act on its own depending on the situation during the match and will prioritize combat by default.
- On defense, if there are no players in the team, the bot will set the bounty itself.
- Battles with bots can also be used to progress in missions

2. Other improvements and bug fixes
- Changed the helmet design for the Welder character
- Optimizations to improve framing
- Fixed gunshot sounds for 2 weapons
- Changes to the office map shape
- Game Nights related UI removed from the lobby
